title: Authorize v0.5.69 provider publication from clean main

Bypassing a failed readiness, rehearsal, Hosted CI, supply-chain, Draft asset, tagged Quick Install, or post-publication gate.

riskAssessment.reason: Publication creates an immutable public tag and Provider assets. Source, tag, metadata, archive, installer, SBOM, provenance, CI evidence, Draft validation, and public Quick Install must remain mutually bound.

authorityEvidence.scope: Publish exactly v0.5.69 after completing all release readiness, same-SHA rehearsal, Hosted, Provider, tagged Quick Install, and post-publication gates; no bypass or historical tag mutation is authorized.

declaredIntent.summary: Publish the prepared v0.5.69 candidate from the exact latest merged main source after all release evidence gates pass.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuing the existing plan through new-version publication; no evidence gate bypass or historical tag mutation is authorized.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user instructed the agent to add publication of a new version after completing the existing objectives. This authorizes only the v0.5.69 release workflow after every declared gate passes.

intent.problem: The preceding Work Item repaired the published v0.5.68 projection and prepared v0.5.69, but the new version is still unpublished. The remaining objective is to execute one evidence-bound v0.5.69 Provider publication from the latest merged main.
constraints: Use only the exact latest origin/main source and the candidate v0.5.69 identity.
Do not mutate v0.5.68 or any historical tag, Release, archive, or unrelated worktree.
Do not create an immutable tag or public asset until all release and Hosted gates pass.
Keep the final Outcome standalone, complete, human-facing, and visible in this conversation.
intent.rationale: A dedicated publication Work Item is required because the predecessor explicitly made publication out of scope; separating the irreversible Provider action preserves source identity, approval, and post-publication evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The candidate, latest merged main, requested tag, and Provider source identity disagree.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Readiness or release preflight fails closed before tag creation and no public release is claimed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run check-release-readiness, resolve exact origin/main, require candidate v0.5.69, and bind the release workflow to the same source SHA.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Same-SHA smoke, compatibility, lockfile, SBOM, provenance, or release evidence is absent, stale, or failed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Publication remains stopped before immutable tag mutation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Dispatch a release rehearsal for the exact source SHA, verify the successful receipt, and require the release workflow to validate all exact-SHA evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The workflow leaves the Release unpublished or fails closed; v0.5.69 is not reported as stable until public verification passes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the release workflow's Draft asset and tagged Quick Install gates, then run check-release-distribution-post-publish against the public tag and assets.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Publication cleanup reaches the historical v0.5.68 identity or unrelated dirty worktrees.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Audit tags, Provider Releases, worktrees, local status, and closure receipt after publication.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The canonical synchronizer promotes v0.5.69 as the stable projection and advances only the next unpublished candidate to v0.5.70.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run sync_published_release_projection.py with the independently downloaded public release.json and release-digests.json, then run release state, distribution, source-bound, and status consistency checks.

acceptance: The Contract records explicit user authority for one v0.5.69 public publication and forbids gate bypasses or historical tag mutation.

The Work Item produces a standalone, complete, human-facing Outcome in the conversation with traffic-light status, implementation approach, evidence, residual risk, and next action.
